commitments.text: 1. Solex shall cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance with the documents listed in Schedule A to this Certificate, collectively comprising the proponent's application.

3. Despite Condition 1 above, Solex may request of authorities required to give approvals, licenses, permits or other authorizations under other enactments for implementation of the Project, variation of the Project design, location, construction, operation, dismantling and abandonment outlined in the documents in Schedule A to this Certificate, in accordance with that authority's approval process, provided that the variation is not a project modification subject to the provisions of the Environmental Assessment Reviewable Projects Regulation (B.C. Reg. 276/95), or a variation outlined in Condition 5 below.

4. Solex must fulfil all commitments and proposed mitigation measures as documented in the application, including such commitments and measures in the supplementary documents and correspondence as listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.

5. Solex must refer any request for varying the location of its proposed plant expansion to the Executive Director of the Environmental Assessment Office, who will determine the appropriate process for reviewing such variation.
6. Solex must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started and constructed the Project within five years of the issue date of this Certificate.

9. Solex must comply with all applicable orders, directions and conditions, and obtain and comply with all applicable tenures, licences, regulations, approvals, standards and permits, or other authorities, which may include or result from, but are not necessarily limited to, the following enactments: (a) Commercial Transport Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 55; (b) Gas Safety Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 149; (c) Health Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 161; (d) Highway Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 167; (e) Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 288; (f) Petroleum & Natural Gas Act, R.S.B.C. 1979 c. 323 including Drilling and Production Regulation; (g) Power Engineers & Boiler & Pressure Vessel Safety Act, S.B.C. 1981, c. 25; (h) Transport of Dangerous Goods Act, S.B.C. 1985, c. 17; (i) Utilities Commission Act, S.B.C. 1980, c. 60; (j) Waste Management Act, S.B.C. 1982, c. 41; (k) Water Act, R.S.B.C. 1979, c. 429.
